title: Revvel Agent Contract (CUDA execution model)
description: Decomposition of one Work Request (Grid) into Blocks and Threads. Produced by the Host from a WR issue; consumed by agent-fallback.yml to dispatch each Thread. Every Block PR must satisfy the contract for its Block. See docs/AGENTS.md § Checkpoint-Gated Grids and docs/CUDA_AGENT_MODEL.md (arriving in Block 4).

contract_version.description: SemVer of this schema. Bump on breaking changes.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the Host run that generated this contract (workflow run URL, script hash, or model name).

wr_number.description: GitHub issue number of the WR that spawned this Grid.

checkpoint_gated.description: True when the WR carries the checkpoint-gated label. Enforces one-Block-per-PR + owner review between Blocks per D011.

goal_phase.description: Which of the five GOAL.md phases this Grid serves (Research/Build/Ship/Monetize/Market).

blocks.description: Ordered list of Blocks that compose the Grid. When checkpoint_gated is true, each Block ships as its own PR and the next Block is not launched until the previous is checkpoint-approved.

id.description: Stable Block id inside this Grid: block-1, block-2, ...

role.description: Fleet lane the Block belongs to. Extend the enum only via a schema version bump.

depends_on.description: Block ids that must reach status=approved before this Block launches. Empty for Block 1.

status.description: Lifecycle position. shipped = PR opened; approved = checkpoint-approved label / next comment / merged.

threads.description: Individual agent invocations that carry out this Block. Each Thread is a workflow_call dispatch of agent-fallback.yml (or an equivalent).

acceptance.description: Deterministic gates that must pass for this Block to be considered complete. Read by the Code Verifier (Block 2, next PR).

id.description: Stable Thread id inside this Block: thread-1, thread-2, ...

kind.description: Which entry in device-tree.yml this Thread invokes.

prompt.description: Task text passed to agent-fallback.yml as task_description. Rendered by the Host from the WR body + Block-specific template.

workspace.description: Optional path prefix that scopes this Thread's file writes. Modeled on BytedTsinghua-SIA/CUDA-Agent's agent_workdir/ convention.

prefer_agent.description: Passed through to agent-fallback.yml. See docs/AGENT_FALLBACK_PROCESS.md.
